name: Ask OpenCity's data
description: Ask a question about OpenCity's urban data for Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune and Mumbai, and get a short data story with charts and sources.
headline: Ask a question.|Get the *story.*
intro: Type a question in plain English. You'll get a short answer with charts, built from tables published on data.opencity.in, with every source one click away.
placeholder: e.g. Which Chennai station had the worst air last winter?

source.name: OpenCity – Urban Data Portal
source.label: data.opencity.in
source.licence: As published on each dataset page (mostly Other, Public Domain)

examples: Which Chennai station had the worst air last winter?
What do people complain to BBMP about most?
How did the BJP do in Pune and Mumbai's 2026 civic polls?
Is Pune's air worse than Bengaluru's?
Cleanest months for air in Bengaluru?
Days Pune breached the PM2.5 limit in 2025?
Bengaluru wards with the most garbage complaints?
Streetlight complaints in Bengaluru over time?
Who won the 2026 Tamil Nadu election?
How fast is Chennai Metro ridership growing?
How low did Chennai's reservoirs fall in 2019?
How did COVID-19 hit Bengaluru's flights?
Which new Bengaluru corporation has the most people?
Karnataka districts with the most crimes in 2025?
Most common traffic offences in Bengaluru?

datasets.title: Chennai Hourly Air Quality Reports
datasets.note: Readings every 15 minutes from 9 Chennai stations, 2024-2025, as daily averages. Snapshot 3 Nov 2026. Licence: Other (Public Domain).

datasets.title: Bengaluru Hourly Air Quality Reports
datasets.note: Readings every 15 minutes from 13 Bengaluru stations, 2024-2025, as daily averages. Snapshot 3 Nov 2026. Licence: Other (Public Domain).

datasets.title: Pune Hourly Air Quality Reports
datasets.note: Readings every 15 minutes from 12 Pune stations, 2024-2025, as daily averages. Snapshot 3 Nov 2026. Licence: Other (Public Domain).

datasets.title: BBMP Grievances Data

datasets.title: BMC Election Results 2026
